title: Transmission permutations and Demazure products in Hurwitz--Brill--Noether theory
summary: A line bundle on a curve with two marked points can be special in many ways, as measured by the global sections of all of its twists by these points. All of this information is conveniently packaged into a permutation, which we call the transmission permutation. We prove that when twice-marked curves are chained together, these permutations are composed via the Demazure product; in reverse, bundles with given permutation can be enumerated via reduced decompositions of a permutation.
